formats.name: System walkthrough
formats.what: A whole product, screen by screen, in one story (CR-101).

formats.name: Day one
formats.what: 'If I built your X, day one looks like this' with a checklist (CR-102).

formats.name: Metaphor truth
formats.what: One honest, contrarian idea told through a simple metaphor (CR-103).

formats.name: 3 problems
formats.what: Hook, then three problems of one business, each with its fix (CR-104, CR-105).
formats.cta: Comment keyword + send to an owner

formats.name: Before / after
formats.what: An old site or none, then the new one, side by side.

formats.name: Feature in 30s
formats.what: One CraftLayer service or real project in 30 seconds.

businesses.hook_hi: Aapka waiter har table par ek saath nahi ho sakta. Aapki website ho sakti hai.
businesses.hook_en: Your waiter can't be at every table. Your website can.

problems.problem: Menu poochne aur order lene mein waiter busy
problems.fix: QR menu se table se hi order

problems.problem: Kitchen tak order late ya galat pahunchta hai
problems.fix: Kitchen display par live orders aur timers
Table par split bill, tip aur UPI

businesses.hook_hi: Agar main aapke cafe ki website banata, toh pehle din se ye hota.
businesses.hook_en: If I built your cafe's website, here's day one.

problems.fix: WhatsApp order aur table booking button

businesses.hook_hi: January mein gym full. March mein khaali kyun?
businesses.hook_en: Packed in January. Empty by March. Why?

problems.problem: Membership khatam, renew ka reminder nahi
problems.fix: Automatic WhatsApp reminder + UPI renew link

problems.problem: Member aana band, kisi ko pata nahi
problems.fix: QR check-in + roz 'kaun nahi aaya' list

problems.problem: Instagram par price poocha, reply agle din

businesses.hook_hi: Customer ne gold rate poochne call kiya, aur phir nahi aaya.
businesses.hook_en: They called for the gold rate and never came in.

problems.problem: Roz wahi sawaal: aaj ka rate?
problems.fix: Website par aaj ka rate, aap ek baar update karo

problems.problem: Designs dekhne dukaan aana padta hai
problems.fix: Catalogue: weight, purity, making + visit booking
Hallmark details, reviews, photos, address ek page par

businesses.hook_hi: Aapke clinic ka phone din mein kitni baar bajta hai sirf 'doctor kab baithte hain' poochne ke liye?
businesses.hook_en: How many calls a day are just 'when is the doctor in?'

problems.problem: Timings aur appointment ke liye calls

businesses.hook_hi: Dentist ka naam sunke hi patient appointment taal deta hai.
businesses.hook_en: Patients put off the dentist. Your website can change that.

problems.problem: Treatment ka kharcha pata nahi, isliye darr
problems.fix: Treatments aur price range website par

businesses.hook_hi: Saturday ko salon full, Tuesday ko khaali. Ye fix ho sakta hai.
businesses.hook_en: Full on Saturday, empty on Tuesday. That's fixable.

problems.fix: Service menu with prices and stylists

businesses.hook_hi: Parents fees se pehle teen cheezein dekhte hain. Aapki website dikhati hai?
businesses.hook_en: Parents check three things before paying fees. Does your website show them?

problems.problem: Results aur faculty ka proof nahi
problems.fix: Results, faculty, batches ek page par

businesses.hook_hi: Har enquiry 'price kya hai?' se shuru hoti hai aur wahi khatam.
businesses.hook_en: Every enquiry starts with 'what's the price?' and ends there.

problems.problem: Har listing ke liye photos WhatsApp karna
problems.fix: Listings page: photos, price, location, video
Enquiry form with budget and timeline

businesses.hook_hi: Client aapko Google karta hai. Kya milta hai?
businesses.hook_en: Clients Google you before they call. What do they find?

problems.problem: Online koi presence nahi, sirf visiting card
problems.fix: Professional site with services and credentials

problems.problem: Consultation fix karne mein back and forth

businesses.hook_hi: Har booking par OTA ko commission. Direct booking kyun nahi?
businesses.hook_en: A commission on every OTA booking. Why not book direct?

problems.fix: Direct booking engine on your site

problems.problem: Guest ke sawaal check-in se pehle

businesses.hook_hi: Aapka best kaam phone ki gallery mein pada hai.
businesses.hook_en: Your best work is stuck in your phone's gallery.

businesses.hook_hi: Contractor ka kaam dikhta hai, par online nahi.
businesses.hook_en: Your work is visible on every street, but not online.

businesses.hook_hi: Shaadi ka season aata hai, aur aapka phone band nahi hota.
businesses.hook_en: Wedding season starts and your phone never stops.

problems.problem: Dates available hain? Har din yahi call

problems.fix: Packages page with capacity and menu

businesses.hook_hi: Gaadi di thi subah, shaam tak koi update nahi.
businesses.hook_en: Dropped the car in the morning. No update by evening.

problems.problem: Customer baar baar call karke status poochta hai

businesses.hook_hi: Pet bimar hai aur clinic ka number nahi mil raha.
businesses.hook_en: Your pet is sick and you can't find the clinic's number.

businesses.hook_hi: Instagram par 'price?' comment aata hai, aur sale wahi ruk jaati hai.
businesses.hook_en: 'Price?' in the comments is where your sale dies.

problems.problem: Har post par price DM karna

problems.fix: Cart to WhatsApp or UPI checkout

businesses.hook_hi: Birthday cake ka order last minute aata hai, aur aapke paas design nahi.
businesses.hook_en: Birthday cake orders come in last minute, with no design picked.

problems.problem: Custom cake ke liye lambi chat

businesses.hook_hi: Aapka customer ab app se order karta hai. Aapse kyun nahi?
businesses.hook_en: Your customers order from apps now. Why not from you?

problems.fix: Your own order page on WhatsApp

businesses.hook_hi: Har package ke liye wahi PDF, wahi itinerary, wahi 20 messages.
businesses.hook_en: The same PDF and the same 20 messages for every package.

problems.fix: Package pages with prices and dates

problems.problem: Custom trip ke liye lambi baat

problems.fix: Booking page with UPI and document upload

businesses.hook_hi: Aapka portfolio Instagram grid mein kho jaata hai.
businesses.hook_en: Your portfolio is lost in your Instagram grid.

businesses.hook_hi: Admission season mein parents ka pehla stop: aapki website.
businesses.hook_en: In admission season, parents start at your website.

problems.fix: Admissions page with dates and fees

problems.problem: Circulars WhatsApp groups mein kho jaate

businesses.hook_hi: Log donate karna chahte hain. Unhe bharosa chahiye.
businesses.hook_en: People want to donate. They need to trust you first.

problems.fix: Impact page with photos and reports

businesses.hook_hi: Marketplace commission aapka margin kha raha hai.
businesses.hook_en: Marketplace commissions are eating your margin.

problems.problem: Customer ka data aapke paas nahi
problems.fix: Your customer list for repeat sales

businesses.hook_hi: Idea pe 6 mahine soch liya. Prototype kab?
businesses.hook_en: Six months thinking about the idea. When's the prototype?

problems.problem: Launch ke baad maintain kaun karega
problems.fix: Code you own, with handover docs

features.hook_hi: Website jo 3 second mein khule, wahi bikti hai.
features.hook_en: Fast sites that load in seconds.

features.hook_hi: Aapka idea, ek product jo log subscribe karein.
features.hook_en: Your idea as a product people subscribe to.

features.hook_hi: AI jo sach mein kaam aaye, sirf demo nahi.
features.hook_en: AI that does a job, not just a demo.

features.hook_hi: Apna store, apne customers, apna margin.
features.hook_en: Your store, your customers, your margin.

features.hook_hi: Jo kaam roz haath se hota hai, wo khud ho.
features.hook_en: The task you do by hand every day, done for you.

features.hook_hi: Excel se business chal raha hai? Ab nahi.
features.hook_en: Running the business on Excel? Not any more.

features.hook_hi: Hum kaise kaam karte hain: scope, weekly demo, handover.
features.hook_en: How we work: scope, weekly demos, handover.

features.hook_hi: 20 industries ke websites, live dekh lo.
Ek college app jo humne banaya aur chalaya.
features.hook_en: A college app we built and run.

features.hook_hi: Google indexing tool jo humne banaya.
